L2+6.000About

About

Three years modelling live Mumbai projects at Computer Help. My core is Revit Structure and rebar: concrete modelled to the bar, bar bending schedules taken straight off the model, and clash-free MEPF coordination in Navisworks before anything reaches site.

BIM Modeller, Quantity Surveyor & BBS Detailer

Computer Help, Navi Mumbai, Aug 2023 to Present

  • Convert 2D AutoCAD concepts into detailed architectural and structural Revit models, with concrete and rebar modelled precisely enough to extract bar bending schedules.
  • Federate architectural, structural and MEPF models and run Navisworks clash detection so conflicts are resolved before construction.
  • Extract bills of quantities from Revit and issue floor plans, GFC shop drawings and as-built sets.
  • Help the BIM manager set day-to-day standards and train architects and junior engineers in Revit.
  • Build parametric Revit families for the office library and render models for client presentations.
